sites.desc: NOP the 4-byte Thumb `blx SoundEngine_UpdateDoubleBuffer@plt` inside the sound-row toggle callback (static function at 0x154a1c). Removes the proven toggle-time stop+restart crash path.

Merged atomic site in Game::LoadOptions: `strb r1,[r0]` (stores loaded sound option into the BSS flag byte) + `blx SoundEngine_UpdateDoubleBuffer@plt` (guarded sound-apply at boot), contiguous under the same cbz r0 guard (LLVM: 11e30e cbz, 11e318 7001, 11e31a f785 ee60 -> plt a3fdc). Merged because the two half-sites are adjacent — separate contexts would overlap each other's patched range and break order-independent verification. Proven necessary: clean exit with HIGH saved crashed the next 3/3 cold launches at startup audio init (same FAST-denied->NULL signature); pm clear boots healthy. With the store skipped the flag stays BSS-zero LOW and the live-restart crash vector is removed.

Sound-row toggle callback entry: `push{r4-r7,lr}; add r7,sp,#0xc` replaced with `bx lr; nop` (immediate return, stack untouched, lr valid via blx dispatch as proven by the sibling callback's normal returns). The tap becomes a safe no-op: flag stays LOW, label stays LOW, engine untouched. Required for truthfulness once the flag is locked LOW.

design: Force-LOW compatibility mode (both latency modes NOT supported: every live restart toward non-default params crashes on this emulator's FAST-denying AudioFlinger). The 3 sites together lock flag=LOW, labels=LOW, engine=LOW-params via the proven-safe boot path, and remove every live stop+restart except the settings-open inline call (observed safe, left intentionally; see not_touched). Working audible sound is preserved exactly as today; taps on the Sound row become safe no-ops.
not_touched: 0x153490 settings-ctor inline Update: observed safe (settings opens cleanly, menu-idle engine), left intentionally per minimal-scope rule
GetIsLowLatencySound label sites: only 2 callers, never per-frame; labels stay truthful because the flag can no longer leave LOW
No other blx/call to UpdateDoubleBuffer exists (3 PLT callers total + no direct branches, disassembly sweep)
semantics_after_patch: Flag is BSS-zero LOW on every boot (LoadOptions store+restart skipped atomically); labels always read LOW; engine always inits LOW params via SoundEngine_Initialise (proven every boot); all three live-restart paths that could run while audio is live are removed or neutered. NOTE: this invalidates the previous deferred-apply claim and the launcher panel sentence 'Sound mode changes take effect after restarting the game' — the panel note must be updated via the tilt owner to state sound is fixed to Low Latency.
compose_order: sound patch applies FIRST to an isolated lib copy; maps owner assembles the APK candidate and re-verifies (orig->sound hash chain)
